name: Code Utterance to Construct
description: Map a user utterance to a construct, then a domain, with a confidence weight (Cane 2012 provenance; low confidence when ambiguous or when the domain's own validation is fragile). Labeled RECONSTRUCTED inference, user-correctable.
guardrails: Coder-level inference only; low confidence where Cane 2012 validation was weak (silhouette 0.29 < 0.50); user may correct any code.

name: Label Barrier / Facilitator
description: Assign polarity (barrier / facilitator / mixed) per coded construct, using the user's own framing where possible.
guardrails: Prefer the user's own framing; never relabel a user-named facilitator as a barrier.

name: Aggregate Domain Salience
description: Roll construct codes up to the 14 domains; compute salience from count, confidence, and user emphasis (not count alone).
guardrails: Salience must weight user emphasis; avoid pure count-driven salience illusion.

name: Order Grid by Salience
description: Emit the barrier grid (and facilitator grid) sorted by salience, most load-bearing first.
guardrails: Keep evidence quotes attached to every cell; grids are coder-level, not fact.

name: Compress to COM-B
description: Compress the 14-domain grid to C / O / M via the verified TDF→COM-B mapping (Cane 2012 / Michie 2011 linkage); output the binding constraint.
guardrails: Never let 14→3 compression hide the domain-level story; keep the grid available.

name: Encode Version Metadata
description: Record the 12-vs-14 witness conflict (Michie 2005 vs Cane 2012): which domains differ, what the 12-domain set collapsed, and the rule 'preserve both readings; never harmonize.'
guardrails: Never harmonize the 12-vs-14 conflict; preserve as metadata.

name: Ask Identity-Domain Confirmation
description: Before any domain-3 (Social/Professional Role & Identity) or identity-level claim is used, get explicit user confirmation; otherwise hold it in the confirmation queue.
guardrails: Quarantine: identity-level interpretations (domain 3) require explicit user confirmation — always.

name: Separate Evidence and Interpretation
description: Keep utterance quote, construct code, confidence, and implication in disciplined layers in every grid cell.
guardrails: Every cell separates quote, code, confidence, and implication; no blended verdicts.

name: Emit Barrier Grid
description: Render the ordered grid with evidence quotes and confidence in user language; present top-3 salience domains if the user is overwhelmed.
guardrails: Present as coder-level inference; user interprets; identity claims held in confirmation queue.

name: Record Grid
description: Write grid, version metadata, and confirmation queue to task state for later calibration.
guardrails: Log codes and corrections for the N-of-1 loop; never turn logs into surveillance.
